testimonials.heading: Loved by educators
testimonials.subtitle: Hear what teachers using Testche every day have to say.

items.name: Dr. Ivan Petrov
items.text: The code block feature is revolutionary. My students can now see properly formatted C# and Python examples directly inside the test interface.

items.name: Maria Georgieva
items.text: I love the point-based grading system. Being able to assign different weights to questions and set custom grade thresholds gives me full control.

items.name: Nikolay Dimitrov
items.text: Creating a test takes only minutes. Image support allows me to include diagrams for algorithm questions — exactly what I needed.

items.name: Georgi Stoyanov
items.text: Students don’t need accounts to take tests. They just enter a code and name. No barriers, and results are available instantly.

items.name: Elena Nikolova
items.text: The dark theme combined with Clerk authentication makes the whole experience feel premium. My students really enjoy taking quizzes here.

howItWorks.metaDescription: Learn how testche works. Create, share, and grade online tests in minutes.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Teachers build custom tests with code blocks, images, multiple choice, true/false, and open-answer questions. Set time limits, point values, and grade thresholds.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Each test gets a unique code. Share it with your students — no account or sign-up required on their end. They just enter the code and their name.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Students answer at their own pace within the time limit. The interface is clean, distraction-free, and works on any device.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Teachers get instant access to results, answer breakdowns, and auto-calculated grades. Review individual submissions or view the full class summary.

about.metaDescription: testche is an online testing platform built for computer science educators and their students.
about.p1: testche is an online testing platform built for computer science educators and their students. Create custom tests with code blocks, images, and point-based grading in minutes.
about.p2: Students join with a simple code — no account or sign-up required. The focus is on removing friction so teachers can assess understanding and students can focus on answering.
about.p3: Built by Daniel Todorov, testche started as a tool to solve a real problem: making programming assessments easier to create, distribute, and grade.

pricing.metaDescription: testche is free for teachers. Create unlimited tests with code blocks, images, and point-based grading.

contact.metaDescription: Get in touch with the testche team.

terms.metaDescription: Terms of service for using testche.
terms.s1Desc: By using testche, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
terms.s2Desc: testche provides an online platform for creating and taking tests. You may not use the service for any unlawful purpose or in violation of any applicable laws.
terms.s3Desc: Teachers are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their account and for all activities that occur under their account.
terms.s4Desc: testche is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. The creators shall not be liable for any damages arising from the use of the service.
terms.s5Desc: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Users will be notified of material changes.

privacy.s1Desc: We collect only the information necessary to provide the service: teacher account details (name, email) and student names for test submissions.
privacy.s2Desc: Information is used solely for test creation, grading, and result display. We do not sell or share personal data with third parties.
privacy.s3Desc: Test data and submissions are stored securely. Teachers can delete their tests and associated data at any time.
privacy.s4Desc: We use essential cookies for authentication and theme preferences. No tracking or advertising cookies are used.
privacy.s5Desc: For privacy-related inquiries, contact us at hello@testche.app.
